definitions.explanation: The act of giving oneself up to the enemy or authorities, ceasing resistance. Used in military, historical, and law enforcement contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{投降|とうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{武器|ぶき}→武器：03605_buki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てて→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧{投降|とうこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The soldiers threw down their weapons and surrendered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{籠城|ろうじょう}→籠城：18926_roujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{守備隊|しゅびたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついに{投降|とうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決意|けつい}した→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧。
examples.english: After a long siege, the castle garrison finally decided to surrender.

notes:
Specifically refers to surrendering to an opposing force — giving up resistance and submitting to the other side. Most commonly used in military and historical contexts, but can also appear in crime/law enforcement reporting when a suspect turns themselves in.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投降|とうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to surrender
- ⟦{無条件|むじょうけん}→無条件：13475_mujouken⟧{投降|とうこう} — unconditional surrender
- {投降|とうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかける→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧ — to call for surrender
- {投降|とうこう}⟦{勧告|かんこく}→勧告：05828_kankoku⟧ — a demand to surrender

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{降伏|こうふく}→降伏：03770_koufuku⟧ — surrender, capitulation; very similar meaning, slightly more formal and often used for formal/national-level capitulation
- ⟦{降参|こうさん}→降参：15127_kousan⟧ — giving up, admitting defeat; lighter, can be used casually (e.g., in games or arguments)
- ⟦{自首|じしゅ}→自首：23257_jishu⟧ — turning oneself in to police; specifically for criminal suspects
